headline: Boulder Dash's amoeba now grows several heads at once
lede: The classic forking blob is finally here: a Boulder Dash amoeba that sprouts perpendicular fingers from a single origin, corners them independently, wraps a stone pillar, then dissolves — never flooding the cavern. FORK BASIN is cave 7, playable now in your pocket.

notes.text: AMO_FORK: a growth head advances AND plants a perpendicular sibling, so one origin becomes a multi-fingered creature that reaches around obstacles — the README's oldest honest gap, closed.

Containment is a law: at most one new head per wave per pass, hard-capped at 4 live fronts, plus generation expiry — the blob fills its pocket, hits the walls, then dissolves. Proven every tick of a planner win-run.
Gates: dashcheck 155/155, 168/168 mutants (new amoFork rule caught), dashplay 42/42 real-key (multi-head confirmed in-browser: 6 fronts, 4 headings). Older caves stay byte-identical.

Reconciled #2428 — the amoeba-family stage had already shipped via slot b; the claim lock didn't see its live checkpoint, so a stale label re-offered shipped work. Fixed the board, credited the author, and still shipped our own game.
